outcome_en: You can name one delivery you should pause before accepting.
outcome_zh: 你能说出一种不该立刻接收的技术交付。
takeaway_move_en: Before I accept this, show me the checkable evidence.
takeaway_move_zh: 我接收之前，先给我可检查的证据。
why_en: Why second: the course has a real edge only if it changes what you accept.
why_zh: 为什么第二课学它：这门课真正有用，必须改变你会直接接收什么。

blocks.body_en:
A useful course does not only tell you what to know. It changes what you can pause.

After this course, you should be able to pause a delivery with no checkable evidence, a plan with no acceptance standard, or a technical suggestion whose tradeoff has not been named.
blocks.body_zh:
一门真正有用的课，不只是告诉你该知道什么。它会改变你能在哪些地方先停一下。

学完这门课，你应该能暂停三类交付：没有可检查证据的交付、没有验收标准的计划、没有说清取舍代价的技术建议。

blocks.anchor_en: Ordering a custom table is easier when both sides agree how to tell whether it fits: size, material, deadline, and where it will be placed.
blocks.anchor_zh: 定做一张桌子时，双方先说清尺寸、材料、交付时间和摆放位置，最后才知道这张桌子算不算合格。
blocks.explain_en: An acceptance standard says what must be true before work counts as done. With AI agents, this matters before code appears: vague goals produce vague success, and vague success is hard to inspect.
blocks.explain_zh: 验收标准，就是提前说清哪些条件满足了，工作才算完成。和 AI agent（AI 代理）合作时，这件事要发生在代码出现之前：目标含糊，成功也会含糊；成功含糊，就很难检查。

blocks.body_en: Pausing is not distrust. It is how a careful collaborator keeps the work legible. You are not saying "I know better than the tool." You are saying "show me what would make this safe to accept."
blocks.body_zh: 暂停不是不信任，而是让协作保持清楚。你不是在说「我比工具懂」，而是在说：「请把能让我放心接收的依据补上。」

exercises.prompt_en: Which delivery should you pause before accepting?
exercises.prompt_zh: 下面哪种交付最应该先停一下，不要立刻接收？
options_en: "I added caching; it should be faster now" with no tradeoff or freshness check
"The script printed the expected three rows"
options_zh: 只说「我加了缓存，现在应该更快」，没有说明取舍，也没有检查数据是否仍然新鲜
说明「运行了 `npm test`，12 个测试通过」
说明「只改了 `copy.ts`，这是代码差异」
说明「脚本打印出了预期的三行」
exercises.explain_en: Caching can be useful, but speed is not free. You need to know what got faster, what may become stale, and how the result was checked.
exercises.explain_zh: 缓存可能很有用，但速度不是白来的。你需要知道哪里变快了、什么可能变旧、结果怎么检查过。

exercises.prompt_en: The phrase for the conditions that make work count as done is acceptance ______.
exercises.prompt_zh: 提前说清「满足哪些条件才算完成」，英文叫 acceptance ______。
exercises.explain_en: Acceptance standard is the phrase to keep. It gives AI, engineers, and you the same finish line.
exercises.explain_zh: acceptance standard（验收标准）是要记住的词。它让 AI、工程师和你看向同一条终点线。
